```python
def unique_jobs(rows):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for r in rows:
        key = (r['source'], r['source_id'])
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        result.append(r)
    return result
```

from jobs import unique_jobs

def test_basic_stable_first_wins():
    rows = [
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'X'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'Y'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '2', 'title': 'X'},
    ]
    out = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert [r['title'] for r in out] == ['X', 'Y'], out

def test_no_cross_source_merge():
    rows = [
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'same'},
        {'source': 'b', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'same'},
    ]
    out = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(out) == 2
    assert {r['source'] for r in out} == {'a', 'b'}

def test_title_not_used():
    rows = [
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'dup'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'other'},
    ]
    out = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(out) == 1

def test_missing_source_id_kept_separately():
    rows = [
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': None, 'title': 't'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '', 'title': 't'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '0', 'title': 't'},
    ]
    out = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(out) == 3

def test_none_and_empty_distinct():
    rows = [
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': None, 'title': 't'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': None, 'title': 'u'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '', 'title': 't'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '', 'title': 'u'},
    ]
    out = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(out) == 4

def test_input_not_mutated():
    rows = [
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'X'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'Y'},
    ]
    snapshot = [dict(r) for r in rows]
    out = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert [r['title'] for r in out] == ['X', 'Y']
    for a, b in zip(rows, snapshot):
        assert a == b

def test_empty():
    assert unique_jobs([]) == []

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_basic_stable_first_wins()
    test_no_cross_source_merge()
    test_title_not_used()
    test_missing_source_id_kept_separately()
    test_none_and_empty_distinct()
    test_input_not_mutated()
    test_empty()
    print('all tests passed')
